newsitem.title: USA: PanAmSat gets final U.S. OK for merger.
newsitem.headline: PanAmSat gets final U.S. OK for merger.

text.p: PanAmSat Corp said on Thursday that it has received final U.S. government approval for its proposed merger with the Galaxy satellite business of Hughes Electronics Corp.
The merger still must be approved by PanAmSat shareholders, who meet on May 8.
If the merger went through as expected, the chairman of the new company would be Charles Noski, who currently is vice chairman and chief financial officer for Hughes Electronics, PanAmSat said.
Frederick Landman, currently PanAmSat's president and chief executive, would have those same duties at the merged company.
PanAmSat shares were trading up 1/2 to 28-1/2 on Thursday. Hughes Electronics shares were at 51-3/4, unchanged on the day. Hughes is a General Motors Corp subsidiary.
